title: Scout Runtime Quality Report
description: Defines the standardized quality evaluation produced for one or more Scout runtime outputs. A Quality Report records the applicable standards, checks performed, findings, scores, blocking issues, corrective actions, approval readiness, and the final quality disposition. It evaluates outputs but does not replace the Execution Result.

requirements.description: All product and process claims must be supported by approved knowledge.
The package must remain consistent with BUXA PDMS positioning.
The package must include six image pages and all requested copy elements.

checks.name: Product Standards Compliance
checks.description: Validate all product and process claims against approved knowledge.

result.summary: All product and process claims are supported by approved knowledge.

checks.name: Brand Standards Compliance
checks.description: Validate positioning, language, and brand boundaries.

result.summary: The package is consistent with BUXA PDMS positioning.

checks.name: Content Standards Compliance
checks.description: Validate page structure, copy format, and requested content components.

result.summary: The package contains all required content components.
result.expected: Six pages, prompts, title, copy, and hashtags

checks.name: Deliverable Completeness
checks.description: Verify every required deliverable has been produced.

disposition.summary: The content package passes all blocking quality checks and may proceed to final execution result assembly.

risk_assessment.notes: The package is not configured for automatic publishing.

approval.notes: Quality evaluation does not publish the content.

confidence.basis: Supported by the referenced Runtime evidence and validation results.
